# recon/docs-from-comments: reference docs generated by the language from its own comment nodes

## Goal (recon ONLY: two plan docs, zero implementation)
Scope a docs rail: ONE dl6 program that joins (a) registry surface/5 construct
rows, (b) comment nodes extracted from the corpus, (c) golden examples, and
emits per-construct reference markdown through a host template. Deliverables:
- plans/2026-08-10-docs-from-comments.PLAN.md (receipts + citations)
- plans/2026-08-10-docs-from-comments.PLAN.visual.human.unga.md (plain words,
  diagrams, zero citations)
A plan without the unga twin is undelivered.

## Receipts to verify and cite (read these FIRST)
- v6/prolog/compile/1_emit_registry_docs.pl — what SYNTAX.md generation
  already covers; the new rail must not duplicate it.
- plans/2026-07-29-comment-node-verdict.md — the seven comment techniques,
  745/745 byte parity on Rust sources, the 57-text-ops-to-host-templates
  constraint, the graded route.
- v6/dl/fixtures/self-map.dl6 — how a dl6 program reads surface/5 today.
- v6/tsv2/goldens/comment_rail_golden/0_comment_rail_golden.dl6 — comment
  runs as dl6 rows, the budget check precedent.
- v6/dl/fixtures/golden-flex.dl6 — the richest doc source: # section per
  construct with a worked example.

## Questions the PLAN must answer, each with a cited receipt
1. ATTACHMENT: which comment-node technique binds a comment run to the
   construct it documents (preceding-decl, section-header, or marker)? What
   does the lab's technique inventory already give?
2. SOURCES: dl6 # comments (fixtures) and Rust are proven. Are prolog %
   comments extractable with the existing extractor, or does phase 1 scope
   to dl6+Rust and leave prolog for later? A14 comment_span ambiguity: state
   its exact open question and whether this rail forces a decision (if yes,
   present it as a fork for the user, do NOT decide it).
3. JOIN SHAPE: surface/5 row -> golden-flex section -> decision row. What
   key joins them (construct name string match? explicit marker?)? Show the
   three-way join as dl6 rules in the plan (rules must compile mentally
   against the shipped surface; cite each construct used).
4. RENDER: the host-template pattern (per the 57-sites finding) that turns
   rows into markdown; which existing rail (devlog/self-map/arch) is the
   closest template to copy.
5. GATE: what staleness check makes generated docs a checked-in artifact
   with a rail (the SYNTAX.md marker-section pattern vs whole-file).

## Rules
- Recon only: no code lands, no fixture edits, no decisions on user forks.
- Every claim carries file:line. A claim without a receipt is a question in
  the plan's open-questions table.
- Style: banned words (provenance, substrate, load-bearing, regime, refusal);
  construct vocabulary rx/prolog/SQL only.

## Commit rail
Commit the two plan docs ON THE BRANCH, one commit, prefix `plans:`. If a
receipt file is missing or contradicts this brief, FAILURE-REPORT.md with the
contradiction, exit nonzero.
